> Can you add clauses stating certainly regarding this statement? For which projects and how the Edgeware will capture the shares?
I'm defining possible ways Edgeware can provide collaborative grants. In the instance you highlight, i am defining the possibility of joint grant then joint investments with VCs in the future which capture equity. Though this one is more medium/long term idea. But it can be an "Edgeware Ventures" department. 

> Will Web3 Foundation publicly acknowledge this Joint Funding Programme (for example, on Twitter)?
Even better than that they can provide a tweet for a every joint project/pallet that is funded. Not saying that we shall use every tweet opportunity to highlight Edgeware Joint Funding Programme, but it is a possibility. However the relationship is more than just tweets, though understandably tweets are great for PR ad visibility. This relationship will grow stronger through collaboration.
